title: Runtime dependency rollup - cross-grid ad-hoc tracker
content:
Purpose: quick, one-page rollup for runtime service dependencies that commonly surface during canaries / rollouts. Not canonical — use as a 5-min lookup for oncall and launch leads.

How to use: scan top table for fast fallbacks and contact; check ‘last smoke’ column before cutovers; add row for new service/regional variant as you discover it.

Notes to self (Maya): low-friction doc, prefer short lines, capture ownership and minimal recovery steps. Populate during 2029-08 canary and keep short.

TABLE (columns): service | primary owner (pager) | SLA class | last smoke test | fallback option | simple recovery step | current instability flag | followup ticket

Rows:
- auth-proxy | Ethan Patel (pager: ethan.p) | P1 | 2029-08-20 (smoke ok) | region-fallback/eu | restart proxy pod, clear KV cache | no | JIRA-OPS-4821
- kv-cache (managed) | Riley Monroe (pager: riley.m) | P2 | 2029-08-10 (flaky under load) | read-through (no-cache) | toggle read-through, schedule full warm-up | yes - perf regression | gh:rw-inference/runtime#2042
- metrics-collector | Sofia Alvarez (pager: sofia.a) | P3 | 2029-07-30 | degrade to sampling mode | flip sampling flag (ops console) | no | confluence:metric-throttle-notes
- model-registry (v2) | Priya Nair (pager: priya.n) | P1 | 2029-08-18 | pinned-models fallback | switch to pinned model tag, restart deploy | partial | JIRA-MODEL-1290
- routing-layer (edge) | Alex Gomez (pager: alex.g) | P1 | 2029-08-19 | region failover | enable region-failover, notify SRE | no | JIRA-EDGE-311
- billing-proxy | Finance SRE (pager: finance-sre) | P3 | 2029-06-12 | degrade to sampling | set billing-sample=1% | no | JIRA-BILL-77

Quick actions (pre-cutover checklist):
- Verify ‘last smoke test’ date is within 14 days for any P1 dependencies. If older, schedule a 15-min warmup before release.
- For any row with ‘instability flag’ = yes, add owner to release channel and require live readiness check.
- Confirm fallback configurations exist in both infra repo and ops console (link above).

Open questions / followups:
- kv-cache: test coverage for cold-starts during large-batch flows — Ethan to add minimal regression test (JIRA-OPS-4923).
- model-registry: clarify policy for pinned-models vs. latest-tag in private deployments — Priya to propose short policy note.
- routing-layer: automate detection of degraded edge nodes and auto-flip to region failover — SRE spike needed (add GH spike).

Ad-hoc logs / one-off observations from 2029-08 canary:
- 2029-08-20 02:12Z: auth-proxy returned 503s correlated with spike in token-validation latency; restart fixed within 3m. Logged in JIRA-OPS-4821.
- 2029-08-20 02:28Z: kv-cache warmed slower than expected for large batch; fallback read-through increased token cost by ~12%. Need estimator for cost delta.

Short TODOs (next 7 days):
- Ethan: add cold-start regression to CI for kv-cache (due 2029-08-27).
- Riley: run a focused warmup run during low-traffic window and capture timings (due 2029-08-24).
- Maya: update this sheet after warmup run and ping launch channel (done 2029-08-22 planned).

Slack pointers / shorthand: see #ops-runtime (thread ts:1692529200.000100) and thread 'canary-aug-20' for full traces.

If you add a new service row, include minimal recovery steps (1-2 lines) and at least one fallback configuration pointer. Keep rows to the point — this is for fast recovery and launch decisioning.

Last note: consider moving stable dependencies to a small, separate maintained roster if this doc stabilizes beyond 3 months.
